reports.verdict: CVS beat forecasts and raised its 2026 outlook, then announced a plan to split into two public companies by the first half of 2028.

takeaways.label: Plan to split up
takeaways.text: CVS intends to separate into two companies: Aetna, Caremark and care delivery under Joyner, and a retail pharmacy business led by Prem Shah. Completion is targeted for the first half of 2028, subject to board and regulatory approval.

takeaways.label: Big beat, higher outlook
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS of $2.09 beat the roughly $1.65 expected. Full-year guidance rose to at least $8.20 from $7.90-$8.10, and cash flow guidance to at least $15.5 billion.

takeaways.label: Insurance recovery continues
takeaways.text: Insurance (Aetna) profit nearly tripled to $912 million as the share of premiums spent on medical care fell to 91.3% from 92.8%, helped by the government business.

takeaways.label: Pharmacy and PBM steady
takeaways.text: Retail pharmacy profit rose 10.6% on prescription growth and Rite Aid files. Pharmacy benefit manager profit grew only 2.7% as price cuts to clients offset higher drug costs.

reports.verdict: Snap's revenue and user numbers missed as big brands cut ad spending, but a strong profit beat and a higher Q4 forecast limited the damage.

takeaways.label: Ad weakness
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 14% to $1.72B, just under the $1.73B expected. Management blamed consumer-goods advertisers pulling back, citing U.S. and Middle East pressures, and pointed to growth in financial services ads.

takeaways.label: Profit beat, Q4 outlook
takeaways.text: Adjusted earnings hit $383M versus $337M expected, and net income was $56M versus a $104M loss a year ago. Q4 revenue guidance of $1.95–1.99B tops the Street's $1.95B.

takeaways.label: User growth slipping
takeaways.text: Daily users reached 495M, below the 499M expected. Snap will make monthly users (977M) its main audience measure from Q1 2027, saying it won't optimize around daily use.

reports.verdict: Uber keeps growing bookings about 20% while profit grows faster, and it is now pushing into self-driving cars.

takeaways.label: Growth and profit
takeaways.text: Gross bookings rose 20% to $59.8B, a fifth straight quarter of 20%+ growth. Operating profit margin hit a record 3.9% of bookings, and adjusted EPS rose 35% to $0.88.

takeaways.label: Q4 outlook
takeaways.text: Uber guides Q4 bookings of $63.25B–$65.25B (18%–22% growth) and adjusted EPS of $0.95–$0.99, up 34%–39%, so growth is expected to hold steady.

takeaways.label: Self-driving push
takeaways.text: Uber expects about 700 fully driverless vehicles on its platform by year-end and over 2,000 in 2027. Debt has risen to $15.7B from $10.5B at the end of 2025.

takeaways.label: Reported numbers look weaker
takeaways.text: Revenue grew only 10% to $14.8B because of accounting changes in how some business is recorded. Reported net income fell 92% to $512M against a year-ago tax benefit.

reports.verdict: Sales guidance narrowed and EPS target lifted, but profit still fell 15% as costs and brand spending outpaced a still-shrinking U.S. business.

takeaways.label: Profit still sliding
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income fell 15.2% to $939M and adjusted EPS fell to $0.53 from $0.61, on rising supply and shipping costs, higher bonuses and more advertising.

takeaways.label: Guidance: sales up, profit flat
takeaways.text: The low end of the sales forecast improved to down 1.25% from down 2%. Operating profit guidance is unchanged at down 16-18%, with gross margin now at the weak end.

takeaways.label: EPS raise is partly tax-driven
takeaways.text: Full-year EPS guidance rose to $2.07-$2.13 from $2.03-$2.09, helped by a lower expected tax rate (23.5% vs 24.5%) and higher other income, not stronger operations.

takeaways.label: U.S. weak, emerging markets strong
takeaways.text: North America organic sales fell 3.2%, with volume down 2.4% in meats, sauces and drinks. Emerging Markets grew 15.6%. Management says trends are improving versus last year.

reports.verdict: Margins improved to a five-year high, but U.S. sales keep shrinking and fourth-quarter revenue is guided lower, to $54–59 million.

takeaways.label: Sales slide continues
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 8.1% to $64.5 million. U.S. sales fell 12.3%, with U.S. retail volume down 20.8% on lost shelf space and weak category demand.

takeaways.label: Lower Q4 outlook
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $54–59 million, below Q3's $64.5 million. The company cited elevated uncertainty and gave no profit outlook.

takeaways.label: Margins and cash burn improve
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 19.3% versus 7.4% a year ago, on cost per pound down 10.1%. Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to $24.6 million from $33.5 million.

takeaways.label: Heavy debt remains
takeaways.text: Cash was $169.3 million against $313.9 million of debt. $14.5 million of 2027 notes come due in March, and the company can't use its at-the-market stock-sale program.

reports.verdict: MetLife posted its best-ever quarterly profit per share, but a big part came from volatile investment gains rather than steadier insurance growth.

takeaways.label: Record, but investment-aided
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS excluding one-time items hit a record $2.85, up 22%. Gains from private-equity-type investments jumped 49% to $720 million, a swingy source.

takeaways.label: Broad underlying growth
takeaways.text: Core revenue excluding pension risk transfers rose 8% to $13.5 billion, growing in all six segments. Group Benefits earnings rose 15% on favorable claims.

takeaways.label: Latin America and Asia softer
takeaways.text: Latin America earnings excluding one-time items fell 5% at constant currency on lower investment returns. Asia sales fell 6% against a strong prior year.

takeaways.label: Annual review dented headline
takeaways.text: The yearly review of insurance assumptions cut adjusted earnings by $46 million, pulling retirement-unit earnings down 6%. Excluding it, that unit rose 12%.

reports.verdict: Chemicals growth and far lower interest costs lifted profit, but Print is shrinking and its profit has nearly vanished.

takeaways.label: Chemicals carry the company
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 21% to $99 million, with operating profit (EBITDA) up to $21 million from $16 million. Growth slowed from last quarter's 40%.

takeaways.label: Print profit nearly gone
takeaways.text: Print revenue fell 7% to $165 million on lower prepress and press volumes. Its operating profit (EBITDA) dropped to $1 million from $8 million a year ago.

takeaways.label: Net income helped by debt paydown
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $21 million from $13 million, mostly because interest expense fell to $3 million from $18 million. Operating profit (EBITDA) rose only $2 million, to $31 million.

takeaways.label: Cash up, costs rising
takeaways.text: Cash rose $27 million to $317 million, but year-to-date operating cash flow is only break-even. Overhead rose to $50 million from $41 million, driven by stock pay and benefit accruals.

reports.verdict: Shopify held 32% growth and a record 22% cash margin, but the first revenue miss in four years and a flat fourth-quarter outlook cooled enthusiasm.

takeaways.label: First revenue miss
takeaways.text: Revenue of $3.74B (up 32%) came in just under analyst estimates of about $3.75B, reportedly the first miss in about four years. Sales volume rose 29% to $119B, also slightly light.

takeaways.label: Cash margin flattered
takeaways.text: The 22% free cash flow margin included temporary boosts: a marketing test, tax timing and an accounting change. The Q4 guide is merely flat with last year's Q4, and Q4 spending steps up.

takeaways.label: Steady holiday outlook
takeaways.text: Q4 revenue growth is guided to the low thirties, matching Q3. Gross profit is guided to grow in the high twenties, and operating costs to run 29–30% of revenue.

takeaways.label: AI shopping still small
takeaways.text: Orders from AI-driven traffic rose 3.3x, but management called volume small. Shopify also paid about $100M for Shop.com and is spending more on AI tools.

reports.verdict: Teva raised 2026 sales guidance again as its three newer brand drugs grew 33%, even as generics shrank and revenue slipped 2%.

takeaways.label: Brand drugs carry growth
takeaways.text: Austedo ($751M, +21%), Ajovy ($269M, +61%) and Uzedy ($85M, +96%) together reached about $1.1B, up 33%, and all three got higher 2026 sales targets.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rose to $16.7–17.0B from $16.5–16.85B. Austedo is now $2.55–2.65B (was $2.45–2.60B). Profit per share outlook is little changed at $1.92–2.11.

takeaways.label: Margins improving
takeaways.text: Adjusted profit per share rose 10% to $0.86 despite 2% lower revenue, as adjusted gross margin hit 58.7% from 55.3%. Reported (GAAP) EPS fell 47% to $0.20 on one-time charges.

takeaways.label: Generics drag, new launches
takeaways.text: U.S. generics fell 39%, mainly generic Revlimid. Teva regained an investment-grade credit rating, and the FDA approved Weltruza, a monthly schizophrenia injection, on Oct 9.

reports.verdict: Pfizer raised 2026 guidance on strong Eliquis and new-drug sales, but flat quarterly revenue shows COVID and vaccine declines still weigh.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rose $1.5B at the midpoint to $62-64B, and EPS to $2.95-$3.05 from $2.80-$3.00, driven by Eliquis and newer drugs.

takeaways.label: Eliquis and new drugs
takeaways.text: Eliquis grew 25% on lower rebates and higher demand. Launched and acquired products rose 32%, and non-COVID sales rose 7%. Padcev jumped 55%.

takeaways.label: COVID and vaccines drag
takeaways.text: Revenue was flat at $16.6B. Paxlovid fell 63%, Comirnaty 29% and Prevnar 10% on lower vaccination rates and shrinking adult share.

takeaways.label: Obesity and patent cliff
takeaways.text: Pfizer targets a first approval for its monthly obesity drug in 2028. It also added $2.5B of 2027-2029 cost cuts to cushion coming patent expiries.

reports.verdict: AMD's Q4 revenue forecast of about $17 billion, up roughly 27% from Q3, shows its new AI server racks are finally ramping.

takeaways.label: Big Q4 guide
takeaways.text: AMD expects about $17 billion in Q4 revenue, plus or minus 3%, up about 66% from last year. Coverage put analyst expectations near $16.3 billion.

takeaways.label: AI data center surge
takeaways.text: Data center sales nearly doubled to a record $8.5 billion, up 97%. Q3 was the first quarter AMD shipped MI455 chips and Helios AI racks for revenue.

takeaways.label: Margins stall
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 56%, flat with Q2, and is guided to about 55% for Q4. Coverage says the new MI450 AI chips are slightly lower-margin than AMD's average.

takeaways.label: Other businesses lag
takeaways.text: Gaming sales fell 40% and Client and Gaming combined fell 8%. Embedded grew 29%, so growth rests on data center.

reports.verdict: Refining profits hit another record on war-inflated margins, and management expects them to stay high through mid-2027 while it sells two refineries for cash.

takeaways.label: Record margins again
takeaways.text: Profit per barrel refined jumped to $45.70 from $17.60 a year ago. Adjusted earnings were $26.93 a share, above the roughly $24.5 analysts expected.

takeaways.label: Margins seen lasting
takeaways.text: Management expects elevated margins through at least mid-2027, citing about 10 million barrels a day of global refining capacity offline, and says it has seen no demand destruction.

takeaways.label: Selling two refineries
takeaways.text: Marathon is selling its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries to CVR Energy for $4.2 billion, with $3.45 billion going to Marathon. Proceeds go mainly to the Gulf Coast.

takeaways.label: Heavy cash return
takeaways.text: Marathon returned $3.3 billion in the quarter, raised its dividend 10% and added a $5 billion buyback authorization. It holds $13.6 billion in cash.

reports.verdict: Record quarter, but Apple guided December gross margin down to 45%–46% as memory costs climb, and gave no outlook past that.

takeaways.label: Margins squeezed by memory
takeaways.text: December-quarter gross margin is guided to 45%–46%, below the 47.9% just reported (about 1 point of which came from tariff refunds) and below the 46.3% analysts expected. Memory prices are still rising.

takeaways.label: Growth slowing
takeaways.text: December-quarter revenue is guided up 7%–10%, down from 12% this quarter. Services is guided up 8%–9%. Mac and iPad supply stays limited by memory availability.

takeaways.label: AI spending climbing
takeaways.text: Operating expenses are expected to rise 11%–13% next quarter on AI investment. R&D already jumped about 32% to $11.7 billion in the September quarter.

takeaways.label: Strong quarter and year
takeaways.text: Revenue was $114.5 billion (up 12%) and EPS $2.10, both September-quarter records. iPhone grew 17% to $57.6 billion and Greater China grew 21%. Full-year revenue hit $479 billion.

reports.verdict: Palantir's revenue nearly doubled again and U.S. commercial sales passed government for the first time, but new contract signings are growing far slower than sales.

takeaways.label: Commercial overtakes government
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue rose 148% to $984M, passing U.S. government revenue ($953M, up 96%) for the first time. Total revenue topped $2B, up 96% to $2.31B.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised sharply
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rose to about $8.53B, roughly 91% growth, from $8.15B. Q4 is guided to about $2.65B, with adjusted operating margin near 62%.

takeaways.label: Bookings lag revenue
takeaways.text: New U.S. commercial contract value grew only 11% to $1.46B, and total contract value grew 6%. Management said several large deals had shorter terms than usual.

takeaways.label: Land-and-expand accelerating
takeaways.text: Pilots are turning into much larger deals, for example $3M to $29M annual value. Customers who stay spend 65% more each year (net retention 165%).
